decision: Promising prompt-only improvement in source meaning and links; retain as experiment, not a production replacement.
changed: Only prompt instructions/examples; schema, catalog, adapter and full request configuration match prior trial.

edge_reviews.rationale: The discrepancy case governs the duty to explain discrepancies. The same source supports the baseline and scope.

The source establishes a remote married-name exception exists but not its contents or limits. Emitting a local exception remains contrary to the trial instructions. The parent wording also risks a blanket married-name exclusion.
The documentary permission exception targets the previous-name prohibition. The converted child retains the after-material-name-change scope of its parent.
The suspension duty and qualification retain more-than-one-year timing, applying on DS-11 and unchanged ID.
The emergency permission and qualification retain all three inherited case limits plus insufficient time before urgent or emergency travel.

Notation before returning documents is an ordering/deadline constraint on notation. The generated prerequisite instead points to the notation duty itself, rather than expressing notation as preceding return. The readable baseline is faithful.
The within-one-year DS-11 case qualifies the no-new-ID exemption without treating the separate documentation duty as its prerequisite.
The separate documentation duty is scoped by within-one-year, DS-11 and unchanged ID.
Failure to meet photo requirements activates the request-for-new-photo duty. The baseline retains context references to the requirements.

The good-likeness prerequisite targets only the hairstyle/facial-hair allowance. It does not target or waive the separate recency recommendation. Its short It statement relies on the parent scope retained by conversion.

review_basis: Manual source review of all 22 baseline statements and all 10 qualifications, plus component outputs and Core issues. Judgments are revisable, not gold annotations.

improvements.result: Statement, scope_text and qualification now preserve more than one year, DS-11, unchanged ID and insufficient time before urgent/emergency travel.
Exemption and conditional documentation duty are separate baselines with their own supported scopes.
Generally-needed-documentation explanation is separate, no longer an applicability condition of notation. A different temporal-link error remains.
Should remains a recommendation. Hairstyle acceptance is a separate permission with a good-likeness prerequisite; no recency exception.
Head support and head tilt split. Newborn emphasis no longer becomes a qualification. Reuse desire and certificate timing caution are separate descriptive possibilities without false links.
All six document options retain exact text and list markers; no rejected baselines or qualifications.

remaining.result: Still emits a local exception for missing married-name content. Parent says except for married names under the section, which may overstate the scope compared with subject to the referenced exception.
The before-returning constraint points as a prerequisite to its own notation duty. Keep faithful timing meaning; the typed relationship does not express the ordering correctly.

remaining.severity: new raw component regression, withheld from graph
remaining.result: All 12 names baselines infer effective start 2026-03-10 from the CT header date. Supplied source does not establish that as legal effectivity. Existing checks flag incomplete timestamps and emit zero EffectivePeriod nodes; they do not prove date-role correctness.
Name-is-part-of-identity fact remains fused with possible identity-evidence requirement. Both prose meanings survive, but they lack independent records and distinct modalities.
The challenge/best-likeness goal remains inside scope_text as well as context, despite no false qualification link.
Repeated short quotations leave object/action/modality evidence ambiguous. Exact passage references did not replace every copied component quotation.
Counterfeiting or alteration and urgent or emergency each use one whole-paragraph alternative reference. Source wording survives, but these do not individually identify each option.

composition_proposal: Keep deterministic source passage catalogs and explicit parent binding as reusable mechanics.
Use full-scope, separate-action guidance to produce source-faithful statements for discovery.
Evaluate relationship typing independently from target binding; uncertainty about relation kind must remain visible.
Assess optional dates, claimants and normalized values independently; retain existing Core admission checks and raw candidates.

If authorized next, compare this all-fields pass with a statements-and-evidence pass followed by targeted enrichment on held-out excerpts; measure omissions, meaning, links and total usage separately.
limits: Two familiar excerpts, one new response each with saved controls. Prompt contains failure-informed invented examples. Improvement does not establish generalization or causation from any single prompt sentence. No default changes or additional calls.
